sacred.light: warm golden, divine rays filtering through ancient stones, halo effects on sacred objects
sacred.fog: thin ethereal mist rising slowly from ground, clinging to stone surfaces
sacred.wind: gentle stillness, occasional sacred breeze that seems to carry whispers
sacred.particles: floating dust motes in light beams, golden sparks of spiritual energy
sacred.sound: distant chanting, resonant silence between breaths, stone humming
sacred.contrast: soft, luminous highlights against deep reverent shadows
sacred.camera_dynamics: slow crane up, reverent push-in, lingering static shots

pre_dawn.light: cool blue transitioning to warm gold, first rays breaking horizon, long dramatic shadows
pre_dawn.fog: ground mist rising from water and stones, thick near ground, thinning upward
pre_dawn.wind: perfectly still, anticipatory silence before the world wakes
pre_dawn.particles: morning dew catching first light, early mist particles floating, breath visible in cold air
pre_dawn.sound: absolute silence broken only by distant bird first call, stone cooling
pre_dawn.color_temperature: cool blue-grey (2700K) transitioning to warm gold (5500K)
pre_dawn.contrast: low contrast, soft gradients, dreamlike quality
pre_dawn.camera_dynamics: slow pan across awakening landscape, time-lapse of light change

military.light: harsh angular lighting, dramatic side-lighting, deep shadows suggesting danger
military.fog: acrid smoke from distant fires, battlefield haze
military.wind: strong gusting wind, flags and cloaks streaming, dust particles
military.particles: sparks from forge fires, ash floating, embers rising
military.sound: distant war drums, clanging metal, urgent movement
military.color_temperature: cool steel blue mixed with fire orange, high contrast
military.contrast: high contrast, dramatic chiaroscuro, deep blacks
military.camera_dynamics: handheld urgency, tracking shots, dramatic crane reveals

ritual.light: firelight and torchlight, warm flickering shadows on stone walls
ritual.fog: incense smoke curling upward, sacred smoke from fire pit
ritual.wind: gentle updraft from fire, smoke spiraling upward
ritual.particles: ember sparks rising, incense particles catching firelight, sacred ash
ritual.sound: rhythmic chanting, drum beats, crackling fire, resonant stone
ritual.contrast: strong firelight contrast, warm highlights, deep shadow areas
ritual.camera_dynamics: slow orbit around fire, intimate close-ups, ritual circle framing

catastrophic.light: dramatic red-orange sky, volcanic glow, ominous shadows
catastrophic.fog: thick ash clouds, smoke billowing, dust storms
catastrophic.wind: violent gale, debris flying, destruction wind
catastrophic.particles: ash, embers, dust, debris, sparks — chaotic airborne matter
catastrophic.sound: thunder, cracking earth, roaring wind, distant explosions
catastrophic.color_temperature: extreme warm (fire) mixed with ash grey, apocalyptic palette
catastrophic.contrast: extreme contrast, blinding light and deep darkness
catastrophic.camera_dynamics: shaky handheld, dramatic crane shots, wide destruction reveals

festive.light: warm abundant firelight, colorful lanterns, joyful illumination
festive.fog: light celebratory smoke from cooking fires, no haze
festive.wind: gentle warm breeze, flags and banners waving cheerfully
festive.particles: flower petals, festive confetti, firefly-like lights
festive.sound: music, laughter, celebration drums, joyful voices
festive.contrast: medium contrast, warm and inviting, no harsh shadows
festive.camera_dynamics: sweeping crane over celebration, intimate crowd shots, joyful tracking

anxious.light: flickering unstable light, shadows moving unpredictably, low-key lighting
anxious.fog: creeping mist, visibility reducing, things half-seen
anxious.wind: unpredictable gusts, eerie silence between, unsettling movement
anxious.particles: dust motes in unstable light, shadows that seem to move
anxious.sound: unnerving silence, distant unexplained sounds, heartbeat-like rhythm
anxious.contrast: low-key, heavy shadows, faces half-lit, unease in darkness
anxious.camera_dynamics: slow dolly into darkness, Dutch angles, uneasy steadicam

neutral.light: balanced natural lighting, clear visibility, neutral tones
neutral.fog: none or very light atmospheric haze
